vision.name: Android 16's Hell Flash
vision.text:
(Villains only. This card is considered Styled. You may only have one "Android 16's Hell Flash" attached.)
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Damage from this attack is banished. Attach to your MP. While attached, your Alignment-restricted cards are considered Styled.
DAMAGE: 6 life cards.
HIT: Raise your anger 2.
